newsitem.title: UK: LME changes two copper brand names.
newsitem.headline: LME changes two copper brand names.

text.p: The London Metal Exchange (LME) approved the change of two copper brand names at a board meeting on October 16, the LME said in notices dated November 1.
The copper brand name "MSEW" has been changed to "BHP COPPER/SXEW", following the change in ownership of the San Manuel refinery from Magma Metals Co to BHP Copper Inc, the LME said.
The "MAGMA" brand name has been changed to "BHP COPPER", also after the change in ownership at the San Manuel refinery.
The new copper brand names will be deliverable for LME warranting purposes with effect from January 1 1997.
With effect from February 1 1997 no further deliveries of "MAGMA" or "MSEW" will be accepted for warranting, the LME said.
Once the stocks of both "MAGMA" and "MSEW" warranted as at January 31 1997 are exhausted, copper branded with these names will no longer be deliverable against the copper contract, the LME added.
